text:
Amir (AE): Heads up — NimbusPay POC is seeing a spike in 5xxs from the hosted endpoint after warmup :warning:
Jules (SE): saw that too, customers hit failing requests when they send batch of ~60 concurrent convs
Maya (Eng Oncall): can you paste a request-id or sample log?
Amir (AE): request-id: r-3b9a7c, attaching snippet below
Amir (AE): ```
2026-03-20T21:02:34Z r-3b9a7c INFO incoming request count=61 seq_len=512 model=redwood-v1
2026-03-20T21:02:34Z r-3b9a7c ERROR no-available-worker: pool=dedicated-1 queued=12
2026-03-20T21:02:34Z r-3b9a7c ERROR responding 503
```
Sanjay (Infra): looks like pool exhaustion + shortfall in burst capacity. Are they hitting a reserved capacity limit or just burst?
Claire (AE): NimbusPay is on the 2-node reserved seat for POC, they asked about temporary burst earlier but we never enabled it
Lena (Solutions): can we spin temporary burst capacity for the POC region? If so, what's the ETA?
Maya (Eng Oncall): I can open a hot patch to allow burst up to +50% in that pool, need approval from infra (Sanjay) and ops.
Sanjay (Infra): I can allow a manual burst for 30m — give me the token and I'll toggle it. We'll monitor KV cache pressure.
Jules (SE): also seeing elevated kv-cache misses in the logs, batching improved throughput but increased mem usage. Might need smaller batch for this tenant as mitigation.
Amir (AE): Customer also pinged about pricing if we enable burst — they want clear temporary pricing. Claire, can you confirm?
Claire (AE): short answer: chargeable at on-demand rate for the burst minutes, we'll honor POC discount if duration < 24h. I'll confirm in thread and send an invoice note.
Nico (Security): FYI customer sent a security questionnaire earlier (scp-nimbus-2026). We need to ensure the temporary burst doesn't create logs with PII retention rules violation. Who's blocking redaction?
Lena (Solutions): we can add request-level redaction for the POC traffic; Maya, can you enable redact-mode=partial for that customer id?
Maya (Eng Oncall): yep, will enable redact-mode=partial and enable burst now. Toggling in 30s.
deploy-bot: deploy started for toggles (change set id: cs-778).
Maya (Eng Oncall): toggles applied. Pool burst +50% enabled. Redact-mode=partial on customer:nimbuspay-id. Monitoring metrics.
Jules (SE): dropping batch size from 60 -> 24 in their client reduces mem pressure. Sent patch suggestion to their devs.
Amir (AE): pinging NimbusPay to ask them to apply small batch immediately. Also told them pricing note from Claire.
Claire (AE): emailed formal note and cc'd finance for a one-off invoice if needed.
Maya (Eng Oncall): errors dropping, 503s down to <1% in the last 2 mins. KV miss rate decreasing.
Sanjay (Infra): keeping the manual burst on for 2 hours to be safe. Will revert after if stable.
Nico (Security): verified redact-mode applied, logs scrubbed of customer PII in last 5m sample.
Lena (Solutions): next steps: (1) recommend client batching to 20-30, (2) SRE to propose autoscale rules for this tenant, (3) security to return completed questionnaire.
Amir (AE): timeline for follow-ups?
Maya (Eng Oncall): I'll write up a short root-cause note and post to this thread in 1h.
Sanjay (Infra): I'll share autoscale proposal by EOD.
Nico (Security): will finish questionnaire review and reply by EOD.
Claire (AE): I'll confirm pricing follow-up and attach invoice draft.
Amir (AE): thanks everyone — big help. I'll keep the customer updated and schedule a 30m sync if they want deeper run-through. :thumbsup:
